user.title: Time settings
user.description: Each anchor of the night period picks its own source: fixed time, sunset or sunrise, with an independent offset.

data.trigger_time: Night start fixed time (when source is fixed)
data.end_time: Night end fixed time (when source is fixed)
data.sun_entity: Sun entity for sunrise/sunset (default: built-in sun.sun; custom entities need next_rising / next_setting attributes)
data.day_enabled: Apply daytime settings after night ends

extra_period.title: Extra period ({position})
extra_period.description: An extra period is a single anchor time: its parameters apply from the start time until the next anchor (e.g. night start).

lights_extra.title: Per-light extra settings
lights_extra.description:
Enable custom parameters per light. Only enabled lights get their own settings page.

{lights}

data.turn_on_listen: Apply settings when a light turns on
data.only_when_on: Only adjust lights that are already on

per_light.title: Per-light override ({position})
per_light.description: Light: {name} (`{entity}`). Fields: night, daytime (if enabled), then one brightness/color-temperature pair per extra period (extra_0 = period 1, etc.).

data.ovr_enable: Use custom parameters for this light

error.no_lights: Please select at least one light
